description: Base spin with no line wins, scatters, or power-up wilds.
Regression: 5 RUNE on payline middle row (positions must match kind=5).
One winning cascade stays at tracker stage 1.
Multiple line wins in one cascade still count as stage 1.
Two separate winning cascades advance to stage 2.
Fourth winning cascade unlocks chest dollar values.
Base tracker reaches stage 5 and applies 2x.
Base tracker reaches stage 6 and applies 3x.
Base tracker reaches stage 7 and applies 5x.
Lightning wild creates extra wilds before the next cascade.
Surge wild increases active chest values after stage 4.
Hammer is collected from a win and consumed after a zero-win cascade.
Golden eagle resolves lightning, surge, and hammer collect in sequence.
Three scatters trigger eight free spins from base.
